card.description: The Slayer. Twenty, lives in Sunnydale with her sister Dawn.

about: Nobody joins the cast by a slip: a name blended from two people's is the person whose first name it is, a misspelling is the person it's a letter from, a name the story never uses makes nobody, and a walk-on the reply names is there at once.

history.content: I hold up the green boots.

reply: "Seven," Buffy told the clerk, whose tag said Chloe. Chloe went to look in the back. "The sign says they close at six," Buffy added, trying the stuck back door on the way past.
